task.download_data.name: Download data
task.empty_garbage.name: Empty garbage
task.align_engine.name: Align engine output
task.swipe_card.name: Swipe card
task.fix_wiring.instructions: Use up and down arrows to hear the left-side wires, and left and right arrows for the right-side ones. Press Enter to connect the selected pair when the tone matches. ESC cancels.
task.download_data.instructions: Hold Space to download the data. Release to pause. ESC cancels.
task.empty_garbage.instructions: Hold Space until you hear the warning, then release and press Space again quickly when you hear the beep. ESC cancels.
task.align_engine.instructions: A beep plays continuously. Use left and right arrows to bring the sound to the center (both ears equal). Press Enter once it's centered to lock in. ESC cancels.
task.swipe_card.instructions: Press Enter at the right moment, between the two beeps, to swipe the card at the correct rhythm. ESC cancels.
